'''Yelyzaveta Lvivna Kordyum''' ({{langx|uk|Єлизавета Львівна Кордюм}}; 1932 {{En dash}} 2024) was a Ukrainian scientist known for her work on biology, plant embryology, and space biology.

== Early life and education ==
Kordyum was born on November 3, 1932, in [[Kyiv]]. She graduated from high school with honors in 1950, and in 1955 competed her studies at [[Taras Shevchenko National University of Kyiv]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite journal |last=Dubyna |first=Dmytro |last2=Ye Kozeko |first2=Liudmyla |last3=Artemenko |first3=Olga |last4=Nedukha |first4=Olena |date=2024-06-29 |title=In memory of Elizabeth Kordyum (03.11.1932 — 27.04.2024) [In Ukrainian: Світлій пам’яті Єлизавети Кордюм (03.11.1932 — 27.04.2024)] |url=https://ukrbotj.co.ua/archive/81/3 |journal=Ukrainian Botanical Journal |language=uk |volume=81 |issue=3 |pages=251–255 |doi=10.15407/ukrbotj81.03 |issn=0372-4123|doi-access=free }}</ref>

== Career ==
Kordyum began work at the M. G. Kholodny Institute of Botany of the [[National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine]] in 1959, and was a junior research fellow at the Academician O. V. Fomin Botanical Garden of [[Kyiv University]].{{Citation needed|date=July 2025}}

Starting in 1976 she was the head of the Department of Cell Biology and Anatomy, a position she held until her death in 2024. She was promoted to professor in 1986.{{Citation needed|date=July 2025}} From 1998 to 2003, she worked as deputy director for Scientific Affairs, and in 1998-1999,  she was acting director of the M. G. Kholodny Institute of Botany of the [[National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine]] . From 2004 to 2024, she was vice-president of the Ukrainian Society of Cell Biology.

== Research ==
Kordyum is known for her work on the impact of gravity on plants, and the adaptation of plants to microgravity. In her research she used electron microscopy to examine how plants sensed gravity.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Kordyum |first=E. L. |last2=Chapman |first2=D. K. |date=2017 |title=Plants and microgravity: Patterns of microgravity effects at the cellular and molecular levels |url=http://link.springer.com/10.3103/S0095452717020049 |journal=Cytology and Genetics |language=en |volume=51 |issue=2 |pages=108–116 |doi=10.3103/S0095452717020049 |issn=0095-4527|url-access=subscription }}</ref>

== Honors and awards ==
In 1979 she received the M.G. Kholodny Prize of the Academy of Sciences of the Ukrainian SSR for her 1979 book ''Evolutionary cytoembryology of angiosperms''.<ref name=":0" /> In 1984 she was named an honored scientist of the Ukrainian SSR.{{Citation needed|date=July 2025}} She received the [[Order of Princess Olga]] award in 1998,{{Citation needed|date=July 2025}} 2003,<ref>{{Cite web |date=May 15, 2003 |title=Про відзначення державними нагородами України наукових працівників |url=https://zakon.rada.gov.ua/laws/show/405/2003#Text}}</ref> and 2007.{{Citation needed|date=July 2025}} In 2020 she was named to the [[International Astronautical Federation]]'s hall of fame.<ref>{{Cite web |last= |first= |date=2020 |title=IAF : 2020 IAF Award Recipients |url=https://www.iafastro.org/news/2020-iaf-award-recipients.html |access-date=2025-06-09 |website=International Astronautical Federation |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last= |first= |title=IAF : Elizabeth KORDYUM |url=https://www.iafastro.org/biographie/elizabeth-kordyum.html |access-date=2025-06-09 |website=International Astronautical Federation |language=en}}</ref> Kordyum was elected a corresponding member of the [[National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine]],<ref name=":0" /> in 2000.{{Citation needed|date=July 2025}}
